cards.name: Aqua Beat
cards.title: Drumming Mermaid
cards.text: [B]: Gains brave until the end of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Yes! I can do it, I know! I won’t ever give up!

cards.name: Sparkle Keys
cards.title: Radiant Pianist
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Music Entity of Chapter 2.
cards.flavor: I want to learn the piano... teach me.

cards.name: Earthy Strums
cards.title: Nature-Loving Guitarist
cards.text: [O]: {1} 1 Entity counts as Music this turn.
cards.flavor: I don’t want anyone to be hurt...!

cards.name: Breezy Strings
cards.title: Whirling Violinist
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Music Word with Echo 1.
cards.flavor: My dream is playing all together... it feels like love...

cards.name: Blazing Melody
cards.title: Fiery Songbird
cards.text: [O]: {1} Up to 3 Entities gain brave this turn.
cards.flavor: What’s up? You worried? We’ll make it! I’ll be with you!

cards.name: Terra Harmonia
cards.title: Earthbound Pianist
cards.text: [O]: {3} Before a fight: 1 defending Music Entity gets +2.
cards.flavor: I’ll sleep a bit... take care, everyone...

cards.name: Luminelle
cards.title: Radiant Songstress
cards.text: [B]: All your Music Entities gain inspiring.
cards.flavor: I hope my voice will reach your heart... and that you’d sing with me.

cards.name: Aqua Serenade
cards.title: Seraphic Violinist
cards.text: Your Music Pianists gain brave and fated, and ignore inoffensive (not inoffensive: +1 instead). When told: your Music Entities get +1.
cards.flavor: I can’t say it with words... I’ll tell you with music.

cards.name: Zephyr Melody
cards.title: Whirlwind Guitarist
cards.text: [B]: Forget 1 card. Remember 1 Music Word with Echo 1 and 1 with Echo 2.
cards.flavor: Now it’s our time... let’s reach the heavens!

cards.name: Pyrothump
cards.title: Inferno Drummer
cards.text: [No effect yet: the Figma card only has a placeholder line.]
cards.flavor: Hey, you, wassup? Stop standing there, and come rock with us!

cards.name: Rhythmic Inferno
cards.title: Flametongue Bassist
cards.text: Your other brave Music Entities get +1.
cards.flavor: Woohoo! We’re gonna ball, guys... better be ready!

cards.name: Volt Strummer
cards.title: Thunderblade Idol
cards.text: Gets +1 for each Music Entity you imagine.
cards.flavor: A great performance can be achieved only if we’re all as prepared.

cards.name: Dante Shadowstrike
cards.title: Enigmatic Idol
cards.text: [O]: {3} Once per turn: remember any Word. To imagine him, forget 2 of your Stories.
cards.flavor: The piano... I’ve given up everyone and everything to master it.

cards.name: Frost Melodist
cards.title: Virtuoso of Ice
cards.text: When an Echo 3 Word lands in your Chant: remember 1 Word from that Chant.
cards.flavor: “Oh my god, he’s too good!” “Encore!! Encore!!”

cards.name: Axel Ironheart
cards.title: Metal Maestro
cards.text: [B]: Forget 1 card. Find Metal Saxophone, Mjölnir’s Roar in your Memories and play it.
cards.flavor: Nobles, we’ve met many. Me and my sax, though: we play for noble hearts.

cards.name: Melodic Sage
cards.title: Li Wei Feng
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Music or Nature Relic.
cards.flavor: There are many things, in this world, that are worth protecting.

cards.name: Enchanting Druid
cards.title: Lucien Songweaver
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Music or Nature Word.
cards.flavor: I’ll play a song for you! Sit here, right beside me!

cards.name: Letitia
cards.title: The Forest Sprite
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Music or Nature Entity.
cards.flavor: All the creatures of the forest... they make me so happy!

cards.name: Pyroblast
cards.title: Heaven’s Drummer
cards.text: With Pyrothump imagined: your Music Entities gain brave (already brave: +2 instead).
cards.flavor: I’ve always dreamt to become as good as my sister... together, we rock!

cards.name: Luna Harmonia
cards.title: The Lost Idol
cards.text: Imagine her only in a new Story, when you imagine a Chapter 2+ Entity. Forgotten when any other Entity is forgotten. Your Music Entities get +2.
cards.flavor: So, you all still remember me... I’ll always be with you.

cards.name: Camelia Nightshade
cards.title: Forlorn Voice
cards.text: [B]: Your Music Entities get +3 this turn. While imagined, they gain brave, charming and defender.
cards.flavor: So then, in the end, you remembered about me. This one song is for you. Keep it, even if I disappear.

cards.name: Familiar Hiroshi
cards.title: Enigmatic Cat Magician
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Fate Relic.
cards.flavor: This is my blessing: may the Master’s sword cut through their foe’s will.

cards.name: Familiar Kuro
cards.title: Infernal Devil Hound
cards.text: After a fight: the Entity it attacked gains starless. If it wins, it gets +1.
cards.flavor: Whether you win or lose, hell will find you soon...

cards.name: Familiar Ryuji
cards.title: Celestial Star Dragon
cards.text: [O]: {1} Continue this Story with 1 Fate Entity of Chapter 2 from your Thoughts. It gains fated (already fated: +1) and inoffensive this turn.
cards.flavor: May the starlit road open to you, master... and bring you to me.

cards.name: Familiar Raiden
cards.title: Thundering Tower Raven
cards.text: [B]: Up to 2 enemy Entities gain starless.
cards.flavor: There’s no blade that cuts through misfortune.

cards.name: Familiar Takeshi
cards.title: Majestic Emperor Lion
cards.text: [B]: 1 other Entity gains fated.
cards.flavor: Fate favors the brave! Rally with me!

cards.name: Kazuki Amagiri
cards.title: Magister Magician
cards.text: [B]: Remember 1 Fate Word with Echo 2. Once per turn, when you Echo: remember 1 Fate Word with Echo 1, then forget 1 card.
cards.flavor: Luck? It’s all about weaving our skills with opportunity. Let’s find the right ones together.

cards.name: Kurogane Ikazuchi
cards.title: Devil’s Adept
cards.text: When it would be told, reveal 1 of your Values instead. When an Entity it fights is told: it gets +1.
cards.flavor: Death? I am no stranger to it. I witness it every time one like you falls. She doesn’t like me either.

cards.name: Hikari Mizuki
cards.title: Blessed by the Star
cards.text: [B]: Your Entities can’t be read until the end of your next turn. While imagined: your Entities gain fated (already fated: +2).
cards.flavor: May the Star bless this city... and our valiant warriors protect it. I will relay your wishes to them.

cards.name: Noboru Amano
cards.title: Fallen Tower Samurai
cards.text: [B]: All enemy Entities gain starless; those already starless are read. When read: 1 of your Entities gains fated.
cards.flavor: The source of my power... will kill me, one day. Until then, may it serve a good ruler.

cards.name: Seiji Tenno
cards.title: The Samurai Emperor
cards.text: [No effect yet: the Figma card only has a placeholder line.]
cards.flavor: It’s not about me... it’s about them. People that are waiting for us. LET’S KEEP OUR HOME SAFE!

cards.name: Prima
cards.title: Keeper of Fate
cards.text: [B]: Your Entities gain timeless and fated; +2 for each they already have. When read: read all your Entities.
cards.flavor: I must keep what’s precious for them... for as long as it’s needed.

cards.name: Rhapsody of Courage
cards.text: Whisper. Before a fight: 1 Entity gains brave this turn. Or, before or during a fight: 1 Entity gets +2 for that fight.
cards.flavor: I’m here, before you, and you will hear what it means to be alive to me.

cards.name: Symphony of Illusion
cards.text: 1 Entity gains stealth this turn. Echo (Whisper), during a fight: the fight ends.
cards.flavor: This melody reminds me of my dream: a world of peace. But I am not there.

cards.name: Harmony of Healing
cards.text: Your Values can’t be revealed until your next turn. Echo: draw 1.
cards.flavor: Wounds of the heart are the deepest: let it reach you, feel better, with me.

cards.name: Crescendo of Chaos
cards.text: Whisper. During a fight: 1 Entity flips 2 more cards.
cards.flavor: I’m raising my voice, and putting all my heart into it: I won’t surrender, ever!

cards.name: Forgotten Voice: Aria
cards.text: Remember 1 Music Entity of Chapter 3 and continue any Story with it.
cards.flavor: There will be a day in which your heart is in trouble: remember me. Call my name.

cards.name: Sakura Blossom Call
cards.text: Not during a fight: remember 1 Fate Entity of Chapter 1 and continue a Story that has a Familiar. Echo: draw 1.
cards.flavor: We familiars can hear the Voice: not only our Masters, but everyone who hears its call.

cards.name: Crimson Vengeance
cards.text: 1 Entity gains brave. When an Entity is told: 1 Entity gets +2 this turn. Echo: forget 1 card, draw 1.
cards.flavor: Some get forgotten. Others are remembered. I won’t ever forget them. AND YOU WON’T EITHER!!!

cards.name: Clear Skies Knowledge
cards.text: Draw 1, forget 1 card, and 1 Entity gains fated. Echo: do it again.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, at night, I watch the sky, and wish good luck to someone. Sometimes, I stay a bit more, and think of you too.

cards.name: Storm Dragon Roar
cards.text: Whisper. Before a fight: the fight ends. During a fight: your Entity gets +3. After a fight your Entity won: draw 1.
cards.flavor: A voice is roaring: run. A body is shouting: fall. A heart is raging: rally.

cards.name: The Way of the Sword
cards.text: Whisper. During a fight: if your Entity is a Samurai, it gains brave, fated, inspiring and timeless this turn; +1 for each it already has.
cards.flavor: Even before you, I am not scared: my heart burns; the wind is fair; my mind is clear; my hand is ready.

cards.name: Magician Blade
cards.title: Fate’s Edge
cards.text: Equip to a Story: its Entity gains fated.
cards.flavor: Odds can be defied, when a soul is strong, and its hands are ready.

cards.name: Fallen’s Shield
cards.title: Impenetrable Doom
cards.text: Your Values can’t be revealed. At the end of your turn: reveal 1 of your Values.
cards.flavor: You won’t be claimed by your opponents: you are property of the Fallen Tower.

cards.name: Star’s Reach
cards.title: Midnight Longbow
cards.text: Forget 1 card. Equip to a Story: its Entity gains sneaky.
cards.flavor: The legend tells that this longbow can hit stars. In fact, it’s the opposite: stars will hit you, when it flings its arrow.

cards.name: Ruler’s Insignia
cards.title: Helm of the Emperor
cards.text: Equip to a Story: its Entity gains inspiring.
cards.flavor: A ruler’s face doesn’t matter: they don’t fight for themselves. Their resolve and heart are those of their people.

cards.name: Devil Drinker
cards.title: Cursed Edge
cards.text: Reveal 1 of your Values. Equip to a Story: its Entity gains dual-striker; it is told at the end of your next turn. Playable from your Reverie.
cards.flavor: This blade claims blood: your enemies’. Your servants’. Your own.
